column1: # CodeQL findings in the vendored crates, each looked at and not a bug.
# codeql-scan.bash can't put a codeql[...] comment in code that cargo vendor
# writes again every run, so they're here instead. A dir names its crate's
# version, so a line goes stale, and fails, when the crate moves, and gets
# looked at again. A new finding fails too.
